verdict.rationale: Poly documents a first-party hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app/mcp with in-browser OAuth, and a runtime probe confirmed it is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. It also ships an official Claude Code plugin that loads Poly memory and connects the MCP server, a poly-cli agent skill, and claims plugin support for Claude, ChatGPT and VS Code, so external LLMs can work directly with Poly files, including Mind notes. Missing for 10: dedicated docs or hands-on corroboration for the ChatGPT and VS Code connectors beyond a marketing line, and evidence of a broader third-party AI plugin ecosystem.
